data.acceptance_change: Acceptance changed by the S03 coordinator after the M7 maths audit (mathematics/chapters/s03/NOTES.md, wip-implementation 6ff60ad). M7.1: rem:s03-T6(c) is wrong at the level maximal at p: H_0 != 0 only if (p-1) | (k-2), and there [l] is trivial mod p, so the +-1 exponent is not observable at maximal level; the exponent test (cohomological (1+l)[l], homological (1+l)[l]^{-1}) is run at U_1(p) for p = 5, k in {7, 9} and p = 7, k in {9, 10} and must distinguish the conventions with exponent +1 cohomologically. At maximal level the asserted claim is 'H_0 = 0 unless (p-1) | (k-2)'. M7.3: the normative (homological) S_l is l^{2-k} (the classical S_l^{-1}); S_l is checked as [l]^2 (cohomological) / [l]^{-2} (homological) on H_0 and as the scalar l^{k-2} / l^{2-k} on the Brandt module. The original claims (H_0 = 0 for 3 <= k <= p+1; T_l = (1+l)[l]^{+-1} for p+3 <= k <= 2p) are still recorded: both hold, the second only non-discriminatingly.

flag_notes.S_l_cohom_[l]^2_hom_[l]^-2: S_l = T_{z_l} derived from hecke_from (gamma = l); vacuous where H_0 = 0; the number of non-vacuous rows where [l]^2 != [l]^{-2} on H_0 is S_l_nonvacuous_discriminating_instances
flag_notes.S_l_scalar_on_P_max: maximal level: S_l is the scalar l^{k-2} (cohom.) / l^{2-k} (homol., M7.3) on the Brandt module
flag_notes.hecke_matches_mf: maximal level, k even: charpoly of T_l = PARI mf on S_k(3)^new (cohom.), = l^{2-k} T_l (homol.)
flag_notes.hecke_matches_mf_U1p: U_1(p), EXPONENT_CASES: charpoly of cohom. T_l = classical T_l on the 3-new forms of Gamma_0(3) cap Gamma_1(p) (PARI mf, all characters mod p)
flag_notes.hecke_relation_ok: T_l^2 - T_{l^2} = l S_l on P, both conventions, first informative l (U_1(p): only if dim W <= 240)
flag_notes.m: maximal level m = 2; U_1(p) at m = 1 except EXTRA_CASES (p = 5, k = 7, m = 2)
flag_notes.original_H0_vanishes_3_le_k_le_p+1: original plan claim (rem:s03-T6 (a)); holds and is consistent with M7.1
flag_notes.original_T_l_p+3_le_k_le_2p_holds_vacuou: original plan claim; for p+3 <= k < 2p it holds vacuously (H_0 = 0), at k = 2p non-discriminatingly ([l] = 1 on H_0 = Z/p); the flag also asserts that no row in this range distinguishes the exponents (M7.1/M7.2)
flag_notes.uninformative primes: l = 11 at p = 5 (l = 1 mod p) and l = 13 at p = 7 (1 + l = 0 mod p) carry no sign information; rows record uninformative_prime

provenance.notes: S03-C4 / T6 (rem:s03-T6): coker alpha with V_k over Z/p^m for B_3, q = 2; epsilon of thm:s03-iharaH0 (a); T_l on H_0 in the cohomological (C4) and homological (if:s02-indef) conventions (exponent table after rem:s03-pm); U_1(p) via Shapiro (W = Ind V_k). H0 = list of exponents e (summand Z/p^e). 'undetermined' = (1+l)[l] and (1+l)[l]^{-1} agree on H_0.
